summary: [¶] Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member [¶] Planning for safe, secure, and reliable integrated operation of the power system during critical periods arising on account of seasonal variations wherein the electricity demand increases rapidly by undertaking specific measures to mitigate the risks on the power system, under clause (h) of sub-section (1) of Section 79 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Regulation 31 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Indian Electricity Grid Code) Regulations, 2023. [¶] In the Order dated 07.10.2024 in Suo-Motu Petition No. 9/SM/2024, the following additions are hereby made: [¶] **2.** In the Respondents list of the Order, the following four Respondents shall be inserted as under: [¶] **Addendum in Suo-Motu Petition No. 9/SM/2024** [¶] **3.** All other terms of the order dated 07.10.2024 in Suo-Motu Petition No. 9/SM/2024 shall remain unaltered. [¶] **(Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Chairperson**
